inputs.name: Sample options
inputs.description: Parameters relating to the sample being analysed.

columns.name: group
columns.description: Group identifier for sample. This will be identical for replicate samples from the same experimental group.

columns.name: replicate
columns.description: Integer representing replicate number. Must start from 1..<number of replicates>.

columns.name: barcode
columns.description: Barcode identifier attributed to that sample during multiplexing. Must be an integer.

columns.name: input_file
columns.description: Full path to FastQ file if previously demultiplexed, BAM file if previously aligned, or a path to a directory with subdirectories containing fastq or fast5 files. FastQ file has to be zipped and have the extension “.fastq.gz” or “.fq.gz”. BAM file has to have the extension “.bam”.

columns.name: fasta
columns.description: Genome fasta file or transcriptome fasta file for alignment. This can either be a local path, or the appropriate key for a genome available in iGenomes config file. Must have the extension “.fasta”, “.fasta.gz”, “.fa” or “.fa.gz”.

columns.name: gtf
columns.description: Annotation gtf file for transcript discovery and quantification and RNA modification detection.

inputs.name: Demultiplexing options
inputs.description: Options required to basecall and demultiplex samples.

input_path.name: Input path
input_path.description: Path to Nanopore run directory files (e.g. 'fastq_pass/*') or a basecalled fastq file that requires demultiplexing.

barcode_kit.name: Barcode kit
barcode_kit.description: Barcode kit used to perform the sequencing e.g. 'SQK-PBK004'.

barcode_both_ends.name: Barcode both ends
barcode_both_ends.description: Require barcode on both ends for basecaller.

trim_barcodes.name: Trim barcodes
trim_barcodes.description: Trim barcodes from the output sequences in the FastQ files from basecaller.

gpu_device.name: GPU device
gpu_device.description: Device specified in GPU mode using '--device'.

gpu_cluster_options.name: GPU cluster options
gpu_cluster_options.description: Cluster options required to use GPU resources (e.g. '--part=gpu --gres=gpu:1').

qcat_min_score.name: Qcat minimum score
qcat_min_score.description: Specify the minimum quality score for qcat in the range 0-100.

qcat_detect_middle.name: Qcat detect middle
qcat_detect_middle.description: Search for adapters in the whole read by applying the '--detect-middle' parameter in qcat.

run_nanolyse.name: Run NanoLyse
run_nanolyse.description: Filter reads from FastQ files using NanoLyse

nanolyse_fasta.name: NanoLyse fasta
nanolyse_fasta.description: Fasta file to be filtered against using NanoLyse

inputs.name: Alignment options
inputs.description: Options to adjust parameters and filtering criteria for read alignments.

aligner.name: Aligner
aligner.description: Specifies the aligner to use i.e. 'minimap2' or 'graphmap2'.

stranded.name: Stranded
stranded.description: Specifies if the data is strand-specific. Automatically activated when using '--protocol directRNA'.

save_align_intermeds.name: Save alignment intermediates
save_align_intermeds.description: Save the '.sam' files from the alignment step - not done by default.

inputs.name: Variant calling options
inputs.description: Options to adjust pameters for DNA varinat calling and structural variant calling.

call_variants.name: Call variants
call_variants.description: Specifies if variant calling will executed.

variant_caller.name: Variant caller
variant_caller.description: Specifies the variant caller that will used to call small variants (available are: medaka, deepvariant, and pepper_margin_deepvariant). Variant calling is only available if '--call_variants' is set and the protocol is set to `DNA`. Please note `deepvariant` and `pepper_margin_deepvariant` are only avaible if using singularity or docker.

structural_variant_caller.name: Structural variant caller
structural_variant_caller.description: Specifies the variant caller that will be used to call structural variants (available are: sniffles and cutesv). Structural variant calling is only available if '--call_variants' is set and the protocol is set to `DNA`.

split_mnps.name: Split MNPs
split_mnps.description: Specifies if MNPs will be split into SNPs when using medaka.

deepvariant_gpu.name: DeepVariant GPU mode
deepvariant_gpu.description: Specifies whether to call variants with pepper_margin_deepvariant in GPU mode.

phase_vcf.name: Phase vcf
phase_vcf.description: Specifies if vcf will be phased when using medaka.

inputs.name: Differential analysis options
inputs.description: Options to adjust quantification and differential analysis.

quantification_method.name: Quantification method
quantification_method.description: Specifies the transcript quantification method to use (available are: bambu or stringtie2). Only available when protocol is cDNA or directRNA.

skip_quantification.name: Skip quantification
skip_quantification.description: Skip transcript quantification and differential analysis.

skip_differential_analysis.name: Skip differential analysis
skip_differential_analysis.description: Skip differential analysis with DESeq2 and DEXSeq.

inputs.name: RNA fusion analysis options
inputs.description: Options to adjust parameters for RNA fusion analysis with JAFFAL.

jaffal_ref_dir.name: JAFFAL reference directory
jaffal_ref_dir.description: Specifies the reference directory for JAFFAL.

skip_fusion_analysis.name: Skip fusion analysis
skip_fusion_analysis.description: Skip differential analysis with DESeq2 and DEXSeq.

inputs.name: RNA modification analysis options
inputs.description: Options to adjust the RNA modification analysis.

skip_xpore.name: Skip xpore
skip_xpore.description: Skip differential modification analysis with xpore.

inputs.name: Process skipping options
inputs.description: Options to skip various steps within the workflow.

skip_qc.name: Skip QC
skip_qc.description: Skip all QC steps apart from MultiQC.

outputs.name: MultiQC report
outputs.description: Results generated by MultiQC for this pipeline collate QC from FastQC, samtools flagstat, samtools idxstats and samtools stats.
